questions.a: A body stays at rest or in uniform straight-line motion unless an unbalanced external force acts on it.

questions.q: Why do passengers jerk forward when a bus stops suddenly?
questions.a: Their bodies tend to keep moving (inertia of motion) even though the bus stops.

questions.q: What is inertia and on what does it depend?
questions.a: The reluctance of a body to change its state of rest or motion; it depends on mass.
